source: Derived 20 October 2026 from the IE agreement clause list (skeletons/ie-agreement.json) and the fee and services schedules of the firm's IE and independent expert agreements.
name: Independent engineer agreement drafting decisions
applyWhere: the clause named above, the definitions, Schedule A (Services), Schedule C (Fees) and any other clause that depends on it
closing: That completes the drafting decisions. What remains are the deal's facts — the parties, the project, the Concession Agreement's date, the term, the fees in each phase, the personnel and the notice details. Give them to me in the chat, or point me at the project documents that hold them, and I will fill each [●].

questions.title: Phases of the services
questions.question: Which phases do the Independent Engineer's services cover? Select all that apply.
questions.location: Schedule A (Services): Part II (Design Phase), Part III (Construction Supervision Services), Part IV (O&M Phase); Article 3 (Services & Related Matters, The Phases)
questions.basis: The firm's IE agreements cover design review, construction supervision and the first years of O&M; a later appointment may cover one phase only.

questions.title: Fee basis
questions.question: How is the Independent Engineer paid?
questions.basis: The firm's IE agreements pay design-phase fees as lump sums, construction supervision by the month and O&M supervision by the year.

options.label: Lump sums per design stage, monthly for construction, yearly for O&M
One lump sum for the whole appointment
Time-based: monthly or man-month rates throughout

questions.title: Payment account
questions.question: Are the fees paid through a dedicated payment account with standing instructions?
questions.location: Article 4 (Funding of the Concessionaire Independent Engineer Payment Account); Schedule E (Form of Standing Instructions)
questions.basis: The firm's IE agreements fund a payment account under standing instructions; a direct-payment appointment drops the schedule.

options.label: Yes — keep the payment account and Schedule E
No — the Concessionaire pays directly; remove them

questions.title: Key performance indicators
questions.question: Is the Independent Engineer held to key performance indicators?
questions.location: Schedule F (Key Performance Indicators); the Liquidated Damages section

options.label: No — remove it and its references

questions.title: Arbitration forum
questions.question: Where will disputes under this agreement be finally resolved?
questions.basis: Owner's decision of 20 October 2026: arbitration has no default and is always asked; the firm's precedents use both the Arbitration Act, 1940 and SIAC.

options.label: Arbitration under the Arbitration Act, 1940, seated in Pakistan
options.hint: The firm's usual forum for a domestic counterparty

options.label: Arbitration under the SIAC Rules, seated in Singapore
options.hint: Where a foreign party or lender asks for an offshore seat

options.label: Another forum
options.hint: State it: another institution or seat, or the courts
